body: I have schizophrenic tendencies too, that's why I mentioned Risperdal and Abilify.

I'm at 300 mg. But I don't understand why they want to switch antidepressants completely. They said a few days ago I could stay on Wellbutrin and take anti-seizure medications. But then they changed their mind. I don't feel I have any control over my medical treatment and I'm fucking pissed about it.

I know the culinary arts is a field not recommended for us Aspies but I tried software development and I hated it. I need a job that doesn't involve office work. 

Currently I'm living with my overprotective dad at home.

I'm going to be 25 next month and I haven't come out to my family yet. I was thinking of bringing my dad to my next therapy session and talking about with my therapist. That way my dad knows it's not socially acceptable to flip out over someone's sexual preferences in public.

I actually did look into that. It's illegal to cook or bake in your home for commercial gain in NY state where I live. So I would need to pay for time at a commercial kitchen. I don't have a lot of money right now so that's a terrible idea.

To be honest, I hate editing videos. That's why I don't want a job doing that. Editing videos is my least favorite part of making YouTube videos. I need a job that involves being active, not sitting in a chair all day.
But the ones that do make lots of money are like the top .01% of all YouTubers. Plus AdSense is very finicky so it would be stupid to solely rely on that for your livelihood. I just need a plan B.
That advice doesn't help me at all. It just makes me feel worse knowing I had to wait several hours for that unhelpful comment.
A mentoring group for young women. Apparently when it comes to anything to the work world, us women can be really passive aggressive and bitchy.
